description: Defines the ServeCommand struct implementing a command-line interface command for running the Swabble service in the foreground. Includes options for configuration, wake word control, and the main run logic managing speech streams and processing.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for running the Swabble service with options for configuration and wake word control.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronous method that loads configuration, manages speech pipeline, processes speech segments, and executes hooks based on wake word detection.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the wake word or its aliases.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes the wake word or its aliases from the input text.
